title_en: A 1+1 apartment is for sale in Fresk on Treasure Street
description_en: A 1+1 apartment with an area of ​​68.5 m², furnished with a mortgage, 3rd floor with a view of the sun and a modernly arranged elevator, is for sale in Fresk, on Treasure Street, near the Spar 2 supermarket. Not sold on credit. The price is 91,000 euros
